results.market_title: Will Coinbase Global, Inc. (COIN) hit (LOW) $160 Week of September 14 2026?
results.reasoning: COIN was trading around $175 as of Sept 11-13, 2026, having consolidated in a $174-$192 range since late August with a weekly low near $171. Hitting $160 requires roughly an 8.5% intraday breakdown below the recent consolidation floor within a single trading week, which, while plausible given COIN's high historical volatility tied to crypto swings, is not supported by current momentum (analyst upgrades, bullish CEO commentary, Goldman raising price target to $219). Absent a fresh crypto-market shock, the probability of touching $160 this week is below the crowd price.

results.market_title: Will S&P 500 (SPY) hit (LOW) $740 Week of September 14 2026?
results.reasoning: SPY is trading around $764 as of mid-September 2026, with the past month's low at $756.64 — meaning $740 requires roughly a 3.1% decline within a single week, below the recent monthly range. This week features a high-stakes FOMC meeting (Sept 15-16) with markets pricing ~90% odds of a rate hike (a hawkish surprise scenario), and VIX has broken out from 6-month lows signaling rising volatility expectations, which modestly elevates tail risk versus a typical calm week. However, a 3%+ single-week drop remains a relatively rare event even amid a hawkish Fed surprise, absent an additional shock (e.g., financial stability scare or unexpectedly large hike).

results.market_title: Will Swedish Social Democratic Party (S) win at least 33% of all valid votes?
results.reasoning: Recent August 2026 polls (Demoskop, PolitPro average) show the Social Democrats polling around 30-31%, having drifted down slightly from a higher of ~32% seen in May 2026 Ipsos poll. To reach the 33% threshold by election day (Sep 13, 2026) would require an upward swing of 2-3 points from current trend, which is plausible but not the base case given the party has consistently polled in the 30-31% range for months.
